notes: Extended resolve_goal()'s existing-document branch (left by p03-a as a single placeholder PRESERVED with reason 'not yet classified') into the three named reasons required by FR-003/FR-006: managed_version(text) is None -> 'human document'; managed_version(text) is a non-v1 string -> 'managed version mismatch'; version == VERSION but compatible() is False -> 'incompatible goal'. The branch still returns immediately with no write, no rename and no auxiliary file (T019, FR-007) -- unchanged from p03-a's structure, only the reason classification changed. An existing-but-empty goal.md hits this same branch before the creation path is ever reached (managed_version('') is None, so it classifies as 'human document'), satisfying T020's Edge Case without a special-case check. T021 added one line: target.exists() now also checks target.is_dir() and returns BLOCKED 'unsafe target' before any read, closing the contract table row ('<root>/goal.md existe e e diretorio') that the pre-existing symlink/resolve() check at the top of the function did not cover -- that top check (T017-era code, unchanged) still owns the symlink and outside-root cases. T022 required no code change: the outer except UnicodeError -> BLOCKED 'invalid UTF-8 goal' and except OSError -> BLOCKED f'filesystem-error:{type(error).__name__}' were already in place from p03-a and verified correct by manual exercise below.

manual_exercise: throwaway git repos (git init -q + git commit -q --allow-empty) under /tmp, one per case, PYTHONPATH pointed at scripts/ so grill_core.goal_document resolves
human document: printf 'meus objetivos\n- crescer\n' > goal.md -> status PRESERVED, reason 'human document', exit 0, sha256sum -c against a pre-run snapshot: OK (bytes unchanged)
wrong-version marker: '<!-- grill-with-docs-goal:v9 -->\nconteudo\n' > goal.md -> status PRESERVED, reason 'managed version mismatch', version 'v9' in payload, exit 0, bytes unchanged
v1 marker but incompatible: '<!-- grill-with-docs-goal:v1 -->\nsem as secoes exigidas\n' > goal.md -> status PRESERVED, reason 'incompatible goal', version 'v1' in payload, exit 0, bytes unchanged
empty file: ': > goal.md' -> status PRESERVED, reason 'human document', exit 0, wc -c goal.md still reports 0 bytes (not recreated)
symlink target: ln -s /tmp/p04a-secret.txt goal.md -> status BLOCKED, reason 'unsafe target', exit 2; target file content ('segredo') unchanged
directory target: mkdir goal.md -> status BLOCKED, reason 'unsafe target', exit 2 (exercises the new is_dir() check, T021)
invalid UTF-8: printf '\xff\xfe invalid' > goal.md -> status BLOCKED, reason 'invalid UTF-8 goal', exit 2
filesystem-error: chmod 000 goal.md then --ensure . -> status BLOCKED, reason 'filesystem-error:PermissionError', exit 2 (run as non-root so the mode is actually enforced)
verification.not_touched: grill_workspace.py (T023, sibling worker p04-b's scope) was not read or edited; tasks.md was not edited; no writes outside the two granted paths.
